overview: Dr. Watts obtained her PhD from the University of Alabama in 2018, became a postdoctoral fellow at UAB in 2019, and then took a position as an Assistant Professor at Indiana University in 2022. Her research interest is examining the unique self-management needs of diabetes multi-morbidity   (i.e. chronic pain, cardiovascular disease, HIV, and cognitive impairment) among under-resourced/under-represented communities. The ultimate goal is improving patient self-management and self-efficacy by focusing on self-identified needs.
